title: Continuous arbitrary-mode location rigidity under subextensive channel information

information_rigidity.class: Any square-integrable continuous, discrete or mixed location law M_N over one common stationary diagonal covariance S_N in a fixed relative K1572 profile band.
information_rigidity.coefficient: The K1616 gain is o(N^4), while K1572 supplies the component floor, so the class infimum coefficient is h_g^prof.
information_rigidity.capacity_test: With A_N=S_N^(-1/2)M_N, I(M_N;X_N)<=1/2 log det(I+Cov(A_N)); log det(I+Cov(A_N))=o(N^3) is sufficient.
information_rigidity.advance: This extends K1596 from an arbitrary zero-mode location law to arbitrary cutoff modes under an explicit information condition.
information_rigidity.scope_guard: The theorem remains Gaussian and common-covariance scoped; it does not control varying covariances, non-Gaussian components, phases, textures, nonstationarity, or unrestricted states.
